summary: AAP 2.6 release overview: automation dashboard for measuring ROI, Ansible Lightspeed intelligent assistant using generative AI, and the self-service automation portal for scaling automation to new users.
questions: What's new in Ansible Automation Platform 2.6?
What are the headline features of AAP 2.6?
Does AAP 2.6 include an AI assistant?

answer_card.title: AAP 2.6 headline features
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Automation dashboard**: measure automation ROI with custom tracking and reports
- **Ansible Lightspeed intelligent assistant**: generative AI chat for on-demand help
- **Self-service automation portal**: point-and-click automation for more users and teams
